reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 03 and targeted source-note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source-note enlargement clearly shows two compact upper rows of indistinct gray marks. The return expands them into three distinct rows with more and larger gray blobs, increasing the marked footprint instead of restoring only the original upper marks. Remove the invented extra row/marks and retain the source-scale upper footprint while keeping the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: Short gray hair with a high receding hairline, gray eyebrows and thin round spectacles remain. The face has only fine gray upper-lip hair, a smooth chin and no beard or added chin hair, with one closed mouth. The near-frontal head/gaze and chest-up crop remain. The dark navy suit, white pointed shirt collar and one dark tie are retained; the rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a long stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque cool blue-gray photographic backing, warm-cream overlapping note, mostly blank lower paper and small right-edge tab remain. Upper gray marks are present rather than blank, but their excessive rows are the separate rejection reason above. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact gray note glyphs are not readable text and their microscopic shapes need not be transcribed. However, the source-page crop clearly resolves two source rows versus three returned rows, so the rejection is based on a visible added row/footprint, not on illegible fine detail.
